definition.object: the surgery recommendation in a doctor-patient consultation: how it is pitched, how doubt is handled, how the patient takes it up
definition.extends: consult_chair_affect: keeps its four axes, uptake codes and teach-back, and adds the three blocks below

pitch_balance.unit: the audible surgery pitch, if one exists

fields.alternatives_named: bool (watchful waiting, medicines, a different procedure, another centre)
fields.timing_named: urgent, elective or if-not-better; the doctor's own staging is not patient deferral

pitch_balance.not: a lecture score; an empty tape is unscorable, not unbalanced

doubt_objects.unit: each named patient fear or pushback about the operation
doubt_objects.rule: whether THAT fear got a reply, not whether the patient is calm; reassurance stays a separate axis

rules: a prompted yes is still accept but flagged
the family later is defer, not refuse

definition.sampling: a chart keyword is not a pitch: score the audible recommendation only; a local referral is still a pitch
not_for: ranking a surgeon before follow-through is joined
